nodes.text: RNA-seq + Epigenomic Integration (fluentGenomics). Bioc Workflow `fluentGenomics` analog: integrate RNA-seq differential genes with ATAC-seq accessibility regions and ChIP-seq TF binding peaks, link peaks to genes via + .

Microarray Normalization Method Comparison (ExpressionNormalizationWorkflow). Bioc Workflow ExpressionNormalizationWorkflow analog: read raw microarray CEL/IDAT files, normalize with multiple methods (RMA, vsn, lumi, ComBat), compare normalization quality via PCA and variance estimation. For normalization quality comparison and method selection ONLY — NOT for differential expression statistical testing. For differential expression analysis from a normalized microarray count matrix, use nf-core/differentialabundance.

CRISPR guide assignment from Perturb-seq sequencing data | guide assignment and barcode demultiplexing from single-cell Perturb-seq CRISPR data → cell-by-guide assignment table and filtered count matrix

Perturb-seq hit calling and differential perturbation analysis vs non-targeting controls | statistical hit calling on single-cell perturbation profiles against non-targeting controls → significant perturbation hit list and filtered phenotype matrix

Perturbation state latent space modeling using scVI and scANVI | deep generative embedding of single-cell perturbation states using scVI and scANVI → low-dimensional perturbation latent space embeddings and cell state representations
Run a complete rare disease workup — I have WES and RNA-seq

RNA-seq Differential Transcript Usage (rnaseqDTU). Bioc Workflow `rnaseqDTU` analog: quantify transcripts (Salmon), import via tximport, then + DEXSeq + stageR for differential transcript usage with FDR control.

BioMate: Subworkflow Sprint 3 — Pseudotime + RNA velocity from single-cell data Runs two orthogonal trajectory methods in parallel: — graph-based pseudotime (R / Monocle3) — RNA velocity (Python / scVelo) Both processes accept the same AnnData h5ad input but are. 2-step pipeline: → . Inputs: csv, h5ad. Outputs: anndata, csv, h5ad, png. Key parameters: adata_h5ad, monocle_cluster, root_cell, velocity_mode.
predict CYP450 inhibition and hepatic clearance for new chemical entity
Run RNA-seq analysis and differential expression

Identify tumor-reactive and exhausted T cell subsets from single-cell RNA-seq data | single-cell RNA-seq transcriptomic profiling and gene signature scoring of tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes to identify tumor-reactive and exhausted CD8+ T cell states → annotated T cell clusters and reactivity scores

Predict tumor neoantigens and candidate HLA-bound peptides | neoantigen prediction and peptide-MHC binding affinity scoring from tumor sequencing data → prioritized candidate neoepitope list with binding affinities

Nanostring GeoMx DSP Analysis (GeoMxWorkflows). Bioc Workflow `GeoMxWorkflows` analog: read Nanostring GeoMx DSP NanoStringGeoMxSet, segment-level QC, Q3 normalization, mixed-model linear DE across regions of interest.

IDAT → Normalisation → Differential Methylation → Gene Enrichment. EPIC/450K array methylation from IDAT — minfi load + functional normalisation, DSS differential methylation, missMethyl gene-set enrichment. Use when you want the DSS-based differential-methylation + enrichment wrapper chain. Also applicable to bismark bisulfite coverage from nf-core/methylseq.

Illumina 450k/EPIC Methylation Array DMR Analysis (methylationArrayAnalysis). Bioc Workflow `methylationArrayAnalysis` analog: read IDAT files via minfi, QC, normalize (SWAN or noob), call DMPs (limma), DMRs (DMRcate), gene-set test (missMethyl).

Public RNA-seq Reanalysis (recountWorkflow). Bioc Workflow `recountWorkflow` analog: pull uniformly-processed counts from recount2/3 for a study (e.g., SRP), scale counts by read length, run DESeq2 DE with technical replicate handling.

Estimate human PK parameters from preclinical animal data (rat, mouse, dog) via allometric scaling | interspecies allometric scaling from preclinical PK data across mouse, rat, or dog to predict human clearance and distribution volume parameters

Run full PBPK compartmental simulation with organ clearance and special population (renal/hepatic impairment) submodel | whole-body physiologically based pharmacokinetic simulation with compartmental model, organ-specific clearance, and renal/hepatic impairment submodels

Characterize population pharmacokinetic variability using Monte Carlo sampling | Monte Carlo population variability simulation and virtual patient PK parameter sampling for dose projection and uncertainty analysis
Run Voyager spatial ESDA on this Visium dataset

RNA-seq processing and differential expression analysis to generate transcriptional signature | differential gene expression analysis on bulk RNA-seq data → per-gene log2 fold changes and adjusted p-values

Find drugs with matching transcriptional signatures using LINCS L1000 / Connectivity Map | transcriptional signature querying against drug perturbation libraries (LINCS L1000 / CMap) → ranked list of candidate compounds with connectivity scores
test compound effect over time at 0, 6, 24, and 72 hours
FDA Phase II to Phase III dose justification brief

Population pharmacokinetic (PopPK) estimation pipeline with NONMEM primary execution and automatic nlmixr2 (R) fallback when NONMEM is unavailable. BYOL (Bring Your Own License) pattern: -- If NONMEM_HOME and NONMEM_LICENSE_FILE are set → run NONMEM nmfe75/nmfe74 -- Otherwise → fall back to nlmixr2 open-source R implementation Pipeline Steps: 1. -- Validate NONMEM-format dataset structure (ID, TIME, DV, etc.) 2. NONMEM_CTL_GENERATE -- Generate NO
Validate SMILES input file (one SMILES+ID per line) | validation, syntax checking, and canonicalization of input chemical structures from a SMILES and compound ID file
RDKit RECAP decomposition into scaffold + R-groups | chemical fragmentation of molecules into core scaffolds and substituent R-groups using RDKit RECAP rules
mmpdb property deltas for fragment swaps | matched molecular pair indexing and property delta quantification for fragment substitutions using mmpdb

Rank novel scaffolds by frequency, drug-likeness, SA score | multi-parameter scoring and ranking of chemical scaffolds by observation frequency, drug-likeness (QED), and synthetic accessibility (SA) score
Validate RNA-seq expression matrix and clinical metadata | quality validation and sample alignment between gene expression matrix and clinical metadata table → validated matrix and metadata

Differential expression analysis using limma-voom with linear modeling, covariates, and eBayes | differential gene expression testing using limma-voom on count matrix with covariate adjustment, eBayes empirical Bayes moderation → logFC, statistics, and adjusted p-values table

Gene signature scoring via GSVA/ssGSEA against MSigDB Hallmark gene sets | single-sample pathway enrichment scoring using GSVA/ssGSEA on expression matrix across MSigDB Hallmark collection → pathway enrichment score matrix and top enriched pathways per group

Phase A: Cardiovascular system safety pharmacology simulation evaluating hERG, cardiac ion channels, and hemodynamic parameters | in silico cardiac ion channel screening and hemodynamic modeling (hERG, Nav1.5, Cav1.2, QTc prolongation risk, blood pressure) from candidate molecular structures → cardiac electrophysiology profile and proarrhythmic risk metrics

Phase B: Central nervous system (CNS) safety pharmacology simulation evaluating neurobehavioral effects, motor coordination, and seizure liability | computational CNS safety pharmacology profiling (blood-brain barrier penetration, off-target neuroreceptor screening, Irwin test / FOB behavioral liability, and seizure threshold prediction) from molecular structure → CNS toxicity profile and neurofunctional risk metrics

Phase C: Respiratory system safety pharmacology simulation assessing respiratory rate, tidal volume, and ventilatory function | in silico respiratory safety pharmacology modeling (respiratory depression, tidal volume, minute volume, plethysmography alteration, and blood gas liability) from compound physicochemical and target profiles → respiratory safety profile and ventilatory impairment thresholds

Phase D: Integrated safety pharmacology synthesis, safety margin calculation, and ICH S7A regulatory dossier generation | integrated safety pharmacology battery synthesis combining cardiovascular, CNS, and respiratory predictions with pharmacokinetic exposure parameters → multi-organ ICH S7A risk matrix, therapeutic safety margins, and regulatory summary report
